# TASK-010 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `61db4762c87b751740ac876f3acd4b5d5655ab9af4b34d551c3fcb54f2991643`

## Required Rules
- `frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-semi-shell-001`: Console UI must use `@douyinfe/semi-ui` as the primary component library; locale/theme shell is configured via `ConfigProvider` in `main.tsx` (and App-level theme helpers), not per-page re-wrapping.
  - rule_sha256=e9c32b34e6df5722515bab5fe2feaca80478baadc99eab5d878ab7e3de3b2a7c verifier=frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-semi-shell-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-directory-001`: Console frontend source must live under `console/frontend/`; HTTP access must go through `src/api.ts` (or thin wrappers over it), not ad-hoc `fetch` in pages/components.
  - rule_sha256=66966dac0eb450b2ddde672de79b7855ccf19b371bc18776d8d0ecb196341a8f verifier=frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-directory-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-api-types-001`: Shared request/response types live in `src/types/api.ts` and are re-exported from `api.ts`; pages/components must not redefine drifting DTOs or hard-code API path strings outside `api.ts`.
  - rule_sha256=da31561ab47f66800d4351fcaf04e354795189e6966f19bd5b78dcb91f2638cc verifier=frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-api-types-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-api-client-001`: All Console HTTP must go through `console/frontend/src/api.ts`: base path `/api/v1`, success only when response `code === 0` then unwrap `data`, failures as `ApiError(status, code?, detail?, requestId?)`, and HTTP 401 must clear token and dispatch `UNAUTHORIZED_EVENT`.
  - rule_sha256=f72980fb8ff80823ef0306b736ff3dfcc9216a23d166c4b3ef9f0c3283c1aafd verifier=frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-api-client-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.frontend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
